user.title: Grand Marquee
user.description: Adds a scrolling marquee card to your dashboards, plus sensors for its messages, news, sports and weather summary.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Grand Marquee is already set up.

init.title: News, sports and weather for the marquee
init.description: Choose what Home Assistant fetches for the marquee. News topics and keywords come from Google News in your Home Assistant language and country. Each marquee then picks what to show in its card settings.

data.news_keywords: News about keywords (one per line, for example a team, your town or a hobby)
data.custom_feeds: Extra news feeds (one web address per line)
data.sports_teams: Teams to follow (one per line, name or abbreviation; empty = all games)
data.weather_entity: Weather for the weather summary sensor (empty = first one found)

error.invalid_feed: Each feed must be a full web address starting with http:// or https://.

add_message.name: Add message
add_message.description: Add a message to the marquee. Re-using an id replaces that message.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Remove the message automatically after this long.

id.name: ID
id.description: Optional id, so you can replace or remove it later.

urgent.name: Urgent
urgent.description: Show it in red across the whole marquee for a few seconds before it joins the scroll.

id.name: ID
id.description: Id of the message to remove.

clear_messages.name: Clear messages
clear_messages.description: Remove every message from the marquee.

messages.name: Messages
messages.description: List of texts or message objects.
